title: Compact Cities & Urban Mobility
goal: Reframe housing and urban-planning debates with sino, sino que and pero
grammar: corrective sino / sino que vs concessive pero in policy arguments

items: I can reframe an urban-planning debate with *no se trata de X, sino de Y*.
I can choose accurately between *sino*, *sino que (además)* and *pero* in complex arguments.
I can use vocabulary for renovation, compact cities, urban sprawl and urban mobility.
